reserveReview.rationale: Tommy Ung & Partners PLT ISAE 3000 (Revised) reasonable-assurance examination as of 30 June 2026 (report dated 2026-07-21, PDF read this pass): MYR 1,817,790.25 cash (81.96%) and MYR 400,000.00 in the Halogen Shariah MYR Liquid Fund (18.04%), totalling MYR 2,217,790.25 exactly equal to 2,217,790.25 MYRC in circulation (zero surplus). Circulation = 6,365,298.65 total supply less 4,147,508.40 authorized-but-not-issued. The report restricts distribution to the Company and discloses BLOX is in Open Beta and not in any Malaysian regulatory sandbox. The prior 100%-cash composition (from the 2025-07-31 report) no longer holds. R13 re-open 2026-08-08: no July 2026 attestation was publicly accessible; the June 2026 composition remains the freshest available.
